info.title: API.SH: JD Sports
info.description: The JD Sports API from API.SH: public JD Sports data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One JD Sports product: id, product code, name, brand, colour, description, fabric, currency, price, highest price, was price, maximum discount, sale/out-of-stock/one-size/exclusive flags, badges, every size (SKU, EAN, price, was price, discount, in stock, partner), colourways, breadcrumbs, images, videos and the product's links on the other JD sites, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jdsports-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product number (e.g. 19714474) or a JD Sports product link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site: GB (default), IE, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, BE, AT, PT, SE, DK, FI.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a JD Sports product with the summary (average rating, review count, recommended ratio, rating histogram, sizing votes): rating, title, text, nickname and location, date, recommends, verified buyer, helpful votes and photos. 10 per page (up to 25).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jdsports-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product number (e.g. 19714474) or a JD Sports product link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site (reviews in that site's language).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, highest, lowest, helpful, media.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: photos
parameters.description: true = only reviews with photos.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, up to 25 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search JD Sports (jdsports.co.uk and 12 European sites) by keywords or category with every facet and sort the site offers. Each product: id, product reference, name, brand, colour, price and price text, discount, sale/in-stock/new flags, exclusivity, sizes, gender, categories, other colourways, image and link, plus `raw`. Also returns `facets` (names, values, counts) and the price range. 48 per page (up to 100).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jdsports-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. Required unless `category` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category as `facets` categoryPageId shows it, e.g. `Men > Mens Footwear > Trainers`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site: GB (default), IE, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, BE, AT, PT, SE, DK, FI.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), latest, price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A facet as name:value (several values with |), repeatable, e.g. `brand:Nike|adidas` or `size:9`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in the site's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in the site's currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, up to 100 (default 48).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One JD Sports store: name, address, city, postal code, phone, coordinates, weekly opening hours and the next seven days' hours, plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jdsports-store

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store number (e.g. 0011, from stores) or a store page link.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site of the store (default GB).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every JD Sports store of a country site (id, name, city, link), optionally filtered by name or city.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/jdsports-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Site: GB (default), IE, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, BE, AT, PT, SE, DK, FI.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only stores whose name or city contains this, e.g. london.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
